title: consent.withdrawn
description: Published by contacts when a number's consent for a channel and purpose becomes withdrawn (data model §10; task 6.4): by the client through the API or dashboard, or by the person with a stop keyword or the preference centre. Withdrawing what's already withdrawn publishes nothing. The number never appears here, since every event is kept in ClickHouse: contact_id names the contact when the number is one of the client's contacts. This is the envelope's data field, not the whole envelope (see platform/events.Envelope).

contact_id.description: The client's contact with this number, when there is one.

actor.description: subject: the person themselves, whose withdrawal only they can undo.
